```{r Data Regresi Logistik}
# Muat library yang dibutuhkan
library("rpart")
library("corrplot")
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr) 
library(tikzDevice) 

# ===================================================================
# ===== SKRIP PRA-PEMROSESAN DAN SELEKSI FITUR (v2 - LENGKAP) =====
# ===================================================================

# Pastikan library dasar dimuat di awal chunk ini untuk mencegah error
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)     # <--- PENTING UNTUK pivot_longer
library(tikzDevice)

# --- FUNGSI BARU UNTUK MENAMPILKAN PERSAMAAN LOGIT ---
print_logit_equation <- function(model, title) {
  cat(paste("\n--- Persamaan Logit untuk:", title, "---\n"))
  coeffs <- coef(model)
  intercept <- coeffs["(Intercept)"]
  predictors <- coeffs[names(coeffs) != "(Intercept)"]
  eq_string <- "logit(p) = \\ln\\left(\\frac{p}{1-p}\\right) = "
  eq_string <- paste0(eq_string, sprintf("%.4f", intercept))
  if (length(predictors) > 0) {
    for (i in 1:length(predictors)) {
      var_name <- names(predictors)[i]
      var_value <- predictors[i]
      var_index <- gsub("x", "", var_name) 
      sign <- ifelse(var_value >= 0, "+", "-")
      value <- abs(var_value)
      term <- sprintf(" %s %.4f x_{%s}", sign, value, var_index)
      eq_string <- paste0(eq_string, term)
    }
  }
  cat("\n--- Salin kode LaTeX berikut: ---\n")
  cat("$$\n")
  cat(eq_string, "\n") 
  cat("$$\n")
  cat("\n--- Daftar Koefisien (untuk referensi): ---\n")
  print(round(coeffs, 6))
  cat("---------------------------------------------\n")
}
# --- AKHIR FUNGSI BARU ---


# ===================================================================
# ===== [PERBAIKAN] ALUR A: PROSES DATA 12 VARS (UNTUK RM3) =====
# ===================================================================
cat("\n--- [PERBAIKAN] Memproses data_processed_12vars (12 prediktor) ---\n")

if (!exists("data")) {
  stop("ERROR: Objek 'data' (12 var) dari Chunk 1 tidak ditemukan.")
}
data_processed_12vars <- data # Ambil data asli dari Chunk 1

# 2. Identifikasi SEMUA prediktor dan var skewed
all_predictor_vars <- paste0("x", 1:12)
all_skewed_vars <- c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x7", "x8", "x11", "x12")

# 3. Terapkan log transform ke semua var skewed
vars_to_log_12 <- intersect(all_skewed_vars, names(data_processed_12vars))
data_processed_12vars[vars_to_log_12] <- log1p(data_processed_12vars[vars_to_log_12])

# 4. Standardisasi SEMUA 12 prediktor
data_processed_12vars[all_predictor_vars] <- as.data.frame(scale(data_processed_12vars[all_predictor_vars]))
cat("--- Selesai memproses data_processed_12vars ---\n")
# ===================================================================


# ===================================================================
# ===== [PERBAIKAN] ALUR B: PROSES DATA 8 VARS (UNTUK RM3 & RM4) =====
# ===================================================================
cat("\n--- [PERBAIKAN] Memproses data_processed_8vars (8 prediktor) ---\n")

# 1. Pastikan 'data1' dari Chunk 1 sudah ada
if (!exists("data1")) {
  stop("ERROR: Objek 'data1' (8 var) dari Chunk 1 tidak ditemukan.")
}

# 2. Identifikasi kelompok var (HANYA untuk 8 var sisa)
kelompok1_vars_8 <- c("x1", "x3", "x7", "x11") # Skewed yg tersisa
kelompok2_vars_8 <- c("x5", "x6", "x9", "x10") # Normal yg tersisa
dependent_var_8  <- "y"

# 3. BUAT DATA FRAME BARU UNTUK DIPROSES (Menggunakan 'data1')
data_processed_8vars <- data1 # <-- INI PERUBAHANNYA

# 4. Terapkan Transformasi Logaritmik (log1p) HANYA ke Kelompok 1 (dari 8 var)
cat("\n--- Menerapkan Log Transformasi ke Kelompok 1 (x1, x3, x7, x11) ---\n")
data_processed_8vars[kelompok1_vars_8] <- log1p(data_processed_8vars[kelompok1_vars_8])
cat("Log Transformasi selesai.\n")

# 5. Lakukan standardisasi (scale) pada 8 var sisa
predictor_vars_final_8 <- setdiff(names(data_processed_8vars), dependent_var_8)
cat("\n--- Menerapkan Standardisasi (Z-Score) ke 8 prediktor ---\n")
data_processed_8vars[predictor_vars_final_8] <- as.data.frame(scale(data_processed_8vars[predictor_vars_final_8]))
cat("Standardisasi selesai.\n")

# >>> KODE BARU TAMBAHAN: Pastikan y adalah faktor untuk plotting
data_processed_8vars$y <- as.factor(data_processed_8vars$y)
# <<< AKHIR KODE BARU TAMBAHAN

# 6. Tampilkan 5 baris pertama (INI DATA UNTUK TABEL ANDA)

print(head(data_processed_8vars, 5))

# ===================================================================

all_predictors_data[vars_to_log] <- log1p(all_predictors_data[vars_to_log])

data_long_full_std <- pivot_longer(all_predictors_data_std,

# ===================================================================
# ===== KODE BOXPLOT DATA STANDARDISASI (SEMUA 12 VARIABEL) =====
# ===================================================================
# Tujuannya: Melihat distribusi outlier setelah data ditransformasi (Log + Scale).
# Data dalam skala Z-score (Mean = 0, SD = 1).

cat("\n--- Membuat Boxplot untuk Data 12 Variabel (Standardized) ---\n")

# 1. Persiapkan Data (Replikasi proses transformasi agar data konsisten)
box_data_raw <- data[, paste0("x", 1:12)]

# Identifikasi variabel skewed
vars_skewed_box <- c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x7", "x8", "x11", "x12")

# a. Transformasi Log
box_data_proc <- box_data_raw
box_data_proc[vars_skewed_box] <- log1p(box_data_proc[vars_skewed_box])

# b. Standardisasi (Z-Score)
box_data_std <- as.data.frame(scale(box_data_proc))

# 2. Ubah ke format Long untuk ggplot
box_long_std <- pivot_longer(box_data_std,
                             cols = everything(),
                             names_to = "Variabel",
                             values_to = "Nilai_Std")

# 3. Atur urutan level agar plot urut (x1, x2, ..., x12)
box_long_std$Variabel <- factor(box_long_std$Variabel, levels = paste0("x", 1:12))

# 4. Buat Boxplot
plot_box_std <- ggplot(box_long_std, aes(x = Variabel, y = Nilai_Std)) +

  geom_boxplot(fill = "lightgreen", color = "black", 
               outlier.colour = "red", outlier.shape = 16, alpha = 0.8) +

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +

# === 5. TAMPILKAN DI CONSOLE ===

cat("Plot .jpg berhasil disimpan.\n")

# === 7. SIMPAN SEBAGAI .TEX (TikZ) ===

tryCatch({

}, error = function(e) {

})
# ===================================================================

# ===================================================================
# ===== KODE BOXPLOT BARU: PERBANDINGAN KLASIFIKASI (8 VAR STANDAR) =====
# ===================================================================
cat("\n--- Membuat Boxplot 8 Var Terhadap Target (y) ---\n")

# 1. Persiapan Data
# Data yang digunakan: data_processed_8vars (8 Var, Log+Scale, y=Factor)
if (!exists("data_processed_8vars")) stop("ERROR: data_processed_8vars tidak ditemukan.")

# 2. Ubah ke format Long untuk ggplot
vars_for_comparison <- setdiff(names(data_processed_8vars), c("x2", "x4", "x8", "x12"))
data_for_compare <- data_processed_8vars[, vars_for_comparison]

box_long_compare <- pivot_longer(data_for_compare,
                                 cols = -y, # Semua kolom kecuali y
                                 names_to = "Variabel",
                                 values_to = "Nilai_Std")

# 3. Atur urutan level agar plot urut
ordered_vars <- c("x1", "x3", "x5", "x6", "x7", "x9", "x10", "x11")
box_long_compare$Variabel <- factor(box_long_compare$Variabel, levels = ordered_vars)

# 4. Buat Boxplot dengan pengelompokan (aes(x = y))
plot_box_compare <- ggplot(box_long_compare, aes(x = y, y = Nilai_Std, fill = y)) +

       fill = "Kelas y") +

    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# === 5. TAMPILKAN DI CONSOLE ===
print(plot_box_compare)

# === 6. SIMPAN SEBAGAI .JPG ===

cat("Plot .jpg berhasil disimpan.\n")

# === 7. SIMPAN SEBAGAI .TEX (TikZ) ===

tryCatch({
  # Buka device TikZ
  tikz(file = "boxplot_y_vs_8vars_std.tex", width = 10, height = 7, verbose = FALSE)

  # Print plot
  print(plot_box_compare)

  # Tutup device

}, error = function(e) {
  message("ERROR: Gagal menyimpan 'boxplot_y_vs_8vars_std' sebagai TikZ.")
  message(e)
  if(names(dev.cur()) == "tikz output") {
    dev.off()
  }
})
# ===================================================================

# ===================================================================
# ===== BAGIAN PEMODELAN AKHIR (UNTUK AIC SELECTION) =====
# ===================================================================
# Model ini dibuat PADA DATA 8-VARIABEL yang sudah diproses
# (data_processed_8vars)

cat("\n--- Menjalankan Model Penuh 8-Var (model_final_8vars) ---\n")
model_final_8vars <- glm(y ~ ., data = data_processed_8vars, family = binomial)

# 9. Lihat summary-nya.
print(summary(model_final_8vars))

# 9b. Tampilkan Persamaan Logit SEBELUM seleksi AIC
print_logit_equation(model_final_8vars, "Model 8-Var (Sebelum Seleksi AIC)")


# 10. Jalankan Seleksi Fitur (Stepwise AIC) pada model 8-var
cat("\n--- Menjalankan Seleksi Fitur Stepwise (stepwise_final) ---\n")
stepwise_final <- step(model_final_8vars, trace = 0) # trace = 0 agar tidak spam

# 11. INILAH HASIL AKHIR AIC ANDA
cat("\n--- HASIL AKHIR SELEKSI FITUR AIC (VALID) ---\n")
print(summary(stepwise_final))

# 11b. Tampilkan Persamaan Logit SETELAH seleksi AIC
print_logit_equation(stepwise_final, "Model SETELAH Seleksi Fitur AIC (Final Model)")
# ===================================================================

# CATATAN:
# model2, stepwise, dll. DIHAPUS dari chunk ini.
# Pemodelan yang valid baru dimulai di CHUNK 2
# SETELAH data 'data1' ini ditransformasi (log1p) dan distandardisasi (scale).
# Variabel 'data1' akan otomatis digunakan oleh Chunk 2.
```

```{r}
# ===================================================================
# ===== INTEGRASI: PEMBAGIAN DATA & EVALUASI MODEL LENGKAP =====
# ===================================================================

# 1. Muat Library
library(caret)
library(pROC)
library(ggplot2)
library(tikzDevice)

set.seed(123) # Seed utama

# ===================================================================
# ===== BAGIAN 1: PERSIAPAN DATA 12 VAR (UNTUK PERBANDINGAN RM3) =====
# ===================================================================
# Asumsi: 'data' (12 var original) sudah ada dari Chunk 1
if (!exists("data")) stop("ERROR: Objek 'data' (12 var) tidak ditemukan.")

# Proses Data 12 Var (Log + Scale) secara independen untuk baseline
data_processed_12vars <- data
vars_skewed_12 <- c("x1", "x2", "x3", "x4", "x7", "x8", "x11", "x12")
data_processed_12vars[vars_skewed_12] <- log1p(data_processed_12vars[vars_skewed_12])
data_processed_12vars[paste0("x", 1:12)] <- scale(data_processed_12vars[paste0("x", 1:12)])
data_processed_12vars$y <- as.factor(data_processed_12vars$y)

# Split Data 12 Var (Independen)
set.seed(123)
idx_test_12 <- createDataPartition(data_processed_12vars$y, p = 0.1, list = FALSE)
test_data_12vars <- data_processed_12vars[idx_test_12, ]
temp_data_12vars <- data_processed_12vars[-idx_test_12, ]

set.seed(123)
idx_val_12 <- createDataPartition(temp_data_12vars$y, p = (0.1/0.9), list = FALSE)
validation_data_12vars <- temp_data_12vars[idx_val_12, ]
train_data_12vars <- temp_data_12vars[-idx_val_12, ]

cat("--- Konfirmasi Pembagian Data 12 Variabel ---\n")
cat("Train:", nrow(train_data_12vars), "| Val:", nrow(validation_data_12vars), "| Test:", nrow(test_data_12vars), "\n\n")


# ===================================================================
# ===== BAGIAN 2: DATA 8 VAR (PUSAT DATA UNTUK SEMUA MODEL) =====
# ===================================================================
# [PERBAIKAN] Menerapkan Stratified Splitting berdasarkan y DAN perbedaan x5 vs x9

# 1. Ambil Data 8 Variabel (data1 dari Chunk 1)
if (!exists("data1")) stop("ERROR: Objek 'data1' (8 var) tidak ditemukan.")

# Pastikan y adalah faktor
data1$y <- as.factor(data1$y)

# 2. [LOGIKA BARU] Buat Stratifikasi Khusus
# Tujuannya: Memaksa baris yang x5 != x9 tersebar merata ke Train/Val/Test
data1$is_diff <- ifelse(data1$x5 != data1$x9, "Beda", "Sama")
data1$strata_group <- interaction(data1$y, data1$is_diff)

cat("--- Statistik Perbedaan x5 vs x9 di Data Asli ---\n")
print(table(data1$is_diff))

# 3. Lakukan Splitting Berdasarkan 'strata_group'
set.seed(123) 

# A. Ambil Data Train (70%)
idx_train <- createDataPartition(data1$strata_group, p = 0.7, list = FALSE)
data_train_asli <- data1[idx_train, ]
data_temp       <- data1[-idx_train, ]

# B. Sisa 30% dibagi menjadi Validasi (10%) dan Test (20%)
# Validasi adalah 1/3 dari sisa data (karena 10% dari total adalah 1/3 dari 30%)
set.seed(123)
idx_val <- createDataPartition(data_temp$strata_group, p = 1/3, list = FALSE) # 1/3 dari sisa

data_val_asli  <- data_temp[idx_val, ]
data_test_asli <- data_temp[-idx_val, ]

# 4. BERSIHKAN KOLOM BANTUAN (PENTING!)
# Kita harus menghapus kolom is_diff dan strata_group agar tidak masuk ke model
hapus_kolom_bantu <- function(df) {
  df$is_diff <- NULL
  df$strata_group <- NULL
  return(df)
}

data_train_asli <- hapus_kolom_bantu(data_train_asli)
data_val_asli   <- hapus_kolom_bantu(data_val_asli)
data_test_asli  <- hapus_kolom_bantu(data_test_asli)

# 5. CEK ULANG (VERIFIKASI)
cat("\n--- Verifikasi Distribusi 'Beda' (x5 != x9) ---\n")
cat("Train :", sum(data_train_asli$x5 != data_train_asli$x9), "baris beda\n")
cat("Val   :", sum(data_val_asli$x5 != data_val_asli$x9), "baris beda\n")
cat("Test  :", sum(data_test_asli$x5 != data_test_asli$x9), "baris beda\n")

# 6. SIMPAN Data Asli ini ke file .RData (Untuk dipakai DT dan RF nanti)
save(data_train_asli, data_val_asli, data_test_asli, 
     file = "Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData")

cat("\nSUKSES: Data asli (8 Var) disimpan ke 'Data_Skripsi_Fixed_8vars.RData'.\n")

# 7. Transformasi Data untuk REGRESI LOGISTIK (Log + Scale)
proses_logreg <- function(df_input) {
  df <- df_input
  # Log hanya untuk var skewed yang tersisa (x1, x3, x7, x11)
  vars_skewed <- intersect(c("x1", "x3", "x7", "x11"), names(df))
  if(length(vars_skewed) > 0) df[vars_skewed] <- log1p(df[vars_skewed])
  
  # Scale semua prediktor
  vars_x <- setdiff(names(df), "y")
  df[vars_x] <- scale(df[vars_x])
  return(as.data.frame(df))
}

train_data_logreg <- proses_logreg(data_train_asli)
val_data_logreg   <- proses_logreg(data_val_asli)
test_data_logreg  <- proses_logreg(data_test_asli)

cat("--- Konfirmasi Ukuran Data Akhir ---\n")
cat("Train:", nrow(train_data_logreg), "| Val:", nrow(val_data_logreg), "| Test:", nrow(test_data_logreg), "\n")

# ===================================================================
# ===== BAGIAN 3: FUNGSI EVALUASI (Tetap Sama) =====
# ===================================================================
generate_model_evaluation <- function(model_formula, train_data, validation_data, test_data, file_suffix) {
  
  plot_title_suffix <- gsub("_", " ", file_suffix)
  cat(paste("\n--- MELATIH MODEL DENGAN SUFFIX:", file_suffix, "---\n"))
  
  # 1. LATIH MODEL
  model_latih <- glm(model_formula, data = train_data, family = binomial)
  cat("\n--- Ringkasan Model (Data Latih) ---\n")
  print(summary(model_latih))
  
  # 2. EVALUASI PADA DATA TES
  cat(paste("\n--- EVALUASI DATA UJI", file_suffix, "---\n"))
  prob_tes <- predict(model_latih, newdata = test_data, type = "response")
  pred_tes <- ifelse(prob_tes > 0.5, 1, 0)
  
  pred_factor_tes <- factor(pred_tes, levels = c(0, 1))
  actual_factor_tes <- factor(test_data$y, levels = c(0, 1))
  report_tes <- confusionMatrix(data = pred_factor_tes, reference = actual_factor_tes, positive = "1")
  
  # Output CM Teks
  print(report_tes) 
  writeLines(capture.output(print(report_tes)), paste0("classification_report_tes", file_suffix, ".txt"))
  
  # Heatmap CM (Tes)
  conf_tes <- table(Actual = test_data$y, Predicted = pred_tes)
  cm_df_tes <- as.data.frame(conf_tes)
  colnames(cm_df_tes) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  
  heatmap_tes <- ggplot(data = cm_df_tes, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Count)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = 1, size = 6, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
    labs(x = "Kelas Prediksi", y = "Kelas Aktual") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  
  # MENAMPILKAN PLOT DI OUTPUT R/PLOT PANE
  print(heatmap_tes) 
  ggsave(paste0("confusion_matrix_tes", file_suffix, ".png"), heatmap_tes, width = 6, height = 5)
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = paste0("confusion_matrix_tes", file_suffix, ".tex"), width = 7, height = 5.5)
    print(heatmap_tes)
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # ROC (Tes)
  roc_tes <- roc(response = test_data$y, predictor = prob_tes, levels = c(0, 1))
  cat("\nAUC (Data Uji):", round(auc(roc_tes), 4), "\n")
  png(paste0("roc_curve_plot_tes", file_suffix, ".png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(roc_tes, main = "", col = "blue", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE, legacy.axes = TRUE)
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
  dev.off()
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = paste0("roc_curve_plot_tes", file_suffix, ".tex"), width = 7, height = 5.5)
    plot(roc_tes, main = "", col = "blue", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE, legacy.axes = TRUE)
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # 3. EVALUASI PADA DATA VALIDASI
  cat(paste("\n--- EVALUASI DATA VALIDASI", file_suffix, "---\n"))
  prob_val <- predict(model_latih, newdata = validation_data, type = "response")
  pred_val <- ifelse(prob_val > 0.5, 1, 0)
  
  pred_factor_val <- factor(pred_val, levels = c(0, 1))
  actual_factor_val <- factor(validation_data$y, levels = c(0, 1))
  report_val <- confusionMatrix(data = pred_factor_val, reference = actual_factor_val, positive = "1")
  
  # Output CM Teks
  print(report_val)
  writeLines(capture.output(print(report_val)), paste0("classification_report_val", file_suffix, ".txt"))
  
  # Heatmap CM (Validasi)
  conf_val <- table(Actual = validation_data$y, Predicted = pred_val)
  cm_df_val <- as.data.frame(conf_val)
  colnames(cm_df_val) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")
  
  heatmap_val <- ggplot(data = cm_df_val, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Count)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = 1, size = 6, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
    labs(x = "Kelas Prediksi", y = "Kelas Aktual") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  
  # MENAMPILKAN PLOT DI OUTPUT R/PLOT PANE
  print(heatmap_val)
  ggsave(paste0("confusion_matrix_validasi", file_suffix, ".png"), heatmap_val, width = 6, height = 5)
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = paste0("confusion_matrix_validasi", file_suffix, ".tex"), width = 7, height = 5.5)
    print(heatmap_val)
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # ROC (Validasi)
  roc_val <- roc(response = validation_data$y, predictor = prob_val, levels = c(0, 1))
  cat("\nAUC (Data Validasi):", round(auc(roc_val), 4), "\n")
  png(paste0("roc_curve_plot_validasi", file_suffix, ".png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(roc_val, main = "", col = "green4", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE, legacy.axes = TRUE)
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
  dev.off()
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = paste0("roc_curve_plot_validasi", file_suffix, ".tex"), width = 7, height = 5.5)
    plot(roc_val, main = "", col = "green4", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE, legacy.axes = TRUE)
    abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # 4. EVALUASI PADA DATA LATIH (TRAIN)
  cat(paste("\n--- EVALUASI DATA LATIH", file_suffix, "---\n"))
  prob_latih <- predict(model_latih, newdata = train_data, type = "response")
  pred_latih <- ifelse(prob_latih > 0.5, 1, 0)
  
  pred_factor_latih <- factor(pred_latih, levels = c(0, 1))
  actual_factor_latih <- factor(train_data$y, levels = c(0, 1))
  report_latih <- confusionMatrix(data = pred_factor_latih, reference = actual_factor_latih, positive = "1")
  
  # Output CM Teks
  print(report_latih)
  writeLines(capture.output(print(report_latih)), paste0("classification_report_latih", file_suffix, ".txt"))

  # Heatmap CM (Latih)
  conf_latih <- table(Actual = train_data$y, Predicted = pred_latih)
  cm_df_latih <- as.data.frame(conf_latih)
  colnames(cm_df_latih) <- c("Actual", "Predicted", "Count")

  heatmap_latih <- ggplot(data = cm_df_latih, aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Count)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black") +
    geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = 1, size = 6, color = "white") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue") +
    labs(title = paste("CM Data Latih", plot_title_suffix), x = "Kelas Prediksi", y = "Kelas Aktual") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"), legend.position = "none")

  # MENAMPILKAN PLOT DI OUTPUT R/PLOT PANE
  print(heatmap_latih)
  ggsave(paste0("confusion_matrix_latih", file_suffix, ".png"), heatmap_latih, width = 6, height = 5)
  tryCatch({
    tikz(file = paste0("confusion_matrix_latih", file_suffix, ".tex"), width = 7, height = 5.5)
    print(heatmap_latih)
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e) { message(e) })
  
  # ROC (Latih)
  roc_latih <- roc(response = train_data$y, predictor = prob_latih, levels = c(0, 1))
  cat("\nAUC (Data Latih):", round(auc(roc_latih), 4), "\n")
  
  png(paste0("roc_curve_plot_latih", file_suffix, ".png"), width = 800, height = 600)
  plot(roc_latih, main = "", col = "darkorange", lwd = 2, print.auc = TRUE, legacy.axes = TRUE)
  abline(a = 0, b = 1, lty = 2, col = "red")
  dev.off()
  
  cat(paste("\n--- EVALUASI SELESAI UNTUK:", file_suffix, "---\n"))

}

# ===================================================================
# ===== BAGIAN 4: EKSEKUSI EVALUASI =====
# ===================================================================

# 1. EVALUASI 12 VARIABEL (Baseline)
# Menggunakan 'train_data_12vars' dst.
cat("\n\n===== MEMULAI EVALUASI: SEBELUM SELEKSI KORELASI (12 VAR) =====\n\n")
generate_model_evaluation(model_formula = y ~ .,
                          train_data = train_data_12vars,
                          validation_data = validation_data_12vars,
                          test_data = test_data_12vars,
                          file_suffix = "_SEBELUM_seleksi_korelasi_12vars")


# 2. EVALUASI 8 VARIABEL (Setelah Hapus Korelasi)
# PENTING: Sekarang menggunakan 'train_data_logreg' (Data Scale yang sinkron dgn file asli)
cat("\n\n===== MEMULAI EVALUASI: SETELAH SELEKSI KORELASI (8 VAR) =====\n\n")
generate_model_evaluation(model_formula = y ~ .,
                          train_data = train_data_logreg,  # <--- DATA BARU
                          validation_data = val_data_logreg, # <--- DATA BARU
                          test_data = test_data_logreg,   # <--- DATA BARU
                          file_suffix = "_SETELAH_seleksi_korelasi_8vars")


# 3. EVALUASI MODEL AIC (Final Model Regresi Logistik)
cat("\n\n===== MEMULAI EVALUASI: SETELAH SELEKSI AIC (FINAL MODEL) =====\n\n")

# Kita jalankan ulang Stepwise AIC di sini agar menggunakan data yang SAMA persis
# (Untuk menjamin validitas ilmiah, AIC harus lari di data training yang sama)
cat("Menjalankan ulang Stepwise AIC pada 'train_data_logreg'...\n")
full_model_aic <- glm(y ~ ., data = train_data_logreg, family = binomial)
stepwise_final <- step(full_model_aic, trace = 0)

formula_final_aic <- formula(stepwise_final)
cat("Formula AIC Terpilih:\n")
print(formula_final_aic)

generate_model_evaluation(model_formula = formula_final_aic,
                          train_data = train_data_logreg, # <--- DATA BARU
                          validation_data = val_data_logreg,
                          test_data = test_data_logreg,
                          file_suffix = "_setelah_seleksi_AIC")

cat("\n\n===== SEMUA TAHAPAN SELESAI (Data untuk DT/RF sudah tersimpan) =====\n\n")

```


```{r}
alias(full_model_aic)
```
```{r}
View(train_data_logreg)
```
